summary.text: Nick Kimble is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 82, an office he has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A healthcare consultant, he holds a bachelor's degree in political science and business from Loyola University Chicago.

paragraphs.text: Nick Kimble earned a bachelor's degree in political science and business from Loyola University Chicago in 2017.
Ballotpedia says his career experience includes working as a healthcare consultant.
Kimble assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Donna Baringer, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Budget Committee and the Commerce Committee.
